text: You are going to investigate the temperature change when aqueous sodium hydroxide neutralises
dilute hydrochloric acid. The equation for the reaction is shown.
Read all of the instructions carefully before starting the experiments.
You are going to do eight experiments.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the appearance of solid N.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Add about 10cm of distilled water to the boiling tube containing solid N. Place a stopper in the
boiling tube and shake the tube to dissolve solid N and form solution N.
Divide solution N into two approximately equal portions in two boiling tubes.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the first portion of solution N add aqueous ammonia slowly until it is in excess and no
further changes are seen.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
To the second portion of solution N add aqueous sodium hydroxide slowly until it is in
excess and no further changes are seen.
Keep the product for (b)(iii).
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Pour about 3cm depth of the product from (b)(ii) into a boiling tube. Add a piece of
aluminium foil and warm the mixture gently. Test any gas produced.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Identify solid N.

tests on solid P

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Carry out a flame test on solid P.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Place solid P in a boiling tube. Add about 10cm of distilled water to the boiling tube. Place a
stopper in the boiling tube and shake the tube to dissolve solid P and form solution P.
Divide solution P into three approximately equal portions in three test-tubes.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
To the first portion of solution P add about 1cm depth of dilute nitric acid and a few drops
of aqueous silver nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
To the second portion of solution P add about 1cm depth of dilute nitric acid and a few
drops of aqueous barium nitrate.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Add the third portion of solution P to the test-tube containing aqueous bromine.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: Identify solid P.
